scientific_integrity: The 1993 fixed-point fold and its equilibrium count are established prior facts. The accepted claim concerns global compact recurrence and an exact stationary activation budget; a relevant 2006 full text was not available for complete comparison.
scientific_limitations: Zero-bias original uncoupled map only; compact fully invariant sets and compactly supported invariant measures; no global forward-convergence assertion or full proof of prior-literature uniqueness.
source_ids: Periodic and chaotic dynamics in a map-based neuron model, arXiv:2111.14499v3
title: Global compact-recurrence threshold and exact activation budget for the zero-bias Chialvo map
